positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description:
- Migrated the entire React Native codebase written in JavaScript to Expos Framework using Typescript.
- Developed custom hooks to handle Firebase authentication, API data fetching, and conditional route rendering.
- Integrated 3rd party components to replace old ones from 2021 that no longer met business requirements.
- Met with the product owner on a weekly basis to discuss deadlines and code reviews.
- Integrated and patched features for the chrome extension hosted on a Node.js server.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Firebase · Apollo GraphQL · Node.js · Mobile Application Development · Back-End Web Development · iOS

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed a mockup of the UI/UX in Figma .
- Created a workspace in Trello for project management to organize tickets, tasks, and project resources.
- Designed, documented, and developed the Frontend foundational architecture utilizing Next.JS and Typescript.
- Assisted in creating a Product Requirement Document by documenting the systems architecture.
- Integrated 3rd party functionality and components that meet business requirements.
- Assisted in designing database schemas and their relationships in PostgreSQL.
- Translated the UI/UX mockup in Next.js by utilizing ShadCN UI components.
- Developed functionality that that imitated middleware on the frontend through Next.js Server actions.
positions.insights: Skills: Figma · Trello · Next.js · Tailwind CSS · ShadcnUI

positions.title: Software QA Intern
positions.description:
● Developed a web page with React.js advertising essential information and event times for a food drive, raised $1.6k worth of canned goods.
● Utilized Angular.js to generate a PDF with data submitted from a web assessment to migrate documentation during meetings from paper to digital, simplifying sharing and accessibility.
● Responsible for flashing 76 infected operating systems during an attack on the network
● Provided IT desk support for users experiencing hardware and software issues.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · Problem Solving · Critical Thinking · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

projects.title: HyperSets
projects.description:
HyperSets is an online platform I made for the HyperX community to store, discover, and illuminate their setup. It offers many profiles to enhance their environment through a combination of wide-ranging lighting effects, such as visual effects for ambient RGB lighting and key binding for games or work. There are also 50+ games to choose from to apply these effects. 

Live site: https://Hyper-sets.com
Github repo: https://github.com/anthonyg56/Shadui-Hypersets

Role:
- Creator

Tools: 
- UI/UX: Figma
- Programming Language: Typescript
- Client/Frontend: NextJS, TailwindCSS, and ShadcnUI 
- APIs/Backend: Supabase, PostgreSQL, Node.Js
- Dev Ops: Vercel - Website host and analytics
- Project Management: Trello

projects.title: Tribe Network
projects.description:
Tribe is a social media platform for exclusive social groups centered around a shared passion, interest, or general commonalities. Tribe's mission is to help cultivate an online environment that empowers users to enjoy the content they love while creating shared intimate moments to keep the flame alive. Project initially was started in 2020 but due to delays and other factors was not completed until 2023.

Live Website: https://www.anthonygayflor.com/tribe
GitHub Repo: https://github.com/anthonyg56/Tribe-NextJS

Role:
- Co-founder

Tools:
- UI/UX: Adobe XD, Miro
- Programming Language: Typescript
- Frontend: Next.js, React, TailwindCSS, 
- Backend: Node.Js, Express.Js (Api's), Passport.Js (Authentication), Multer (File Upload), Cloudinary (Cloud image hosting)
- Project Management: Trello
- DevOps: Vercel
